# Fiteo

> Fiteo is a mindful-eating app for iPhone and Android. Save a recipe, your own or one from an Instagram reel, adjust it with a substitute that fits your goal, and see how the meal fits into your day. Calories and macros are estimates: the more detail you give (amounts, brands), the closer the result.

- Platforms: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Languages: English, Polish, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese
- Pricing: free to try; Fiteo Pro is a subscription (monthly or yearly) with a free trial
- Fiteo is not a medical device and does not replace advice from a doctor or dietitian.

## Main features

- Save recipe reels: share an Instagram reel to Fiteo and get the recipe with ingredients, steps, servings, and calories & macros per serving.
- Substitutes: swap one ingredient (for example cottage cheese, sugar, butter, sour cream) and see the new estimate for the whole recipe.
- Log meals by describing them in your own words, by voice or with a photo.
- Day balance: food vs. activity from Apple Health or Health Connect, against your goal.
- Share a recipe as a link; the recipient opens it in the browser or in their own Fiteo.

## Pages (English)

- [Home](https://fiteoapp.io/en/): what Fiteo does, download links
- [Save a recipe from Instagram](https://fiteoapp.io/en/save-instagram-recipe): turn a recipe reel into a saved recipe with calories per serving
- [Ingredient substitutes](https://fiteoapp.io/en/substitutes): swaps for [cottage cheese](https://fiteoapp.io/en/substitutes/cottage-cheese), [sugar](https://fiteoapp.io/en/substitutes/sugar), [butter](https://fiteoapp.io/en/substitutes/butter) and [sour cream](https://fiteoapp.io/en/substitutes/sour-cream)
- [Calorie calculator](https://fiteoapp.io/en/calorie-calculator): daily calorie needs from age, height, weight and activity
- [How accurate is Fiteo?](https://fiteoapp.io/en/accuracy): published test on 100 dishes, misses included
